description:
About the job

Description

We are looking for a Sr. Social and Creators Product Manager for the Amazon Mexico business to drive growth for the Amazon Mexico Stores via automated (performance) marketing channels.

We are looking for a marketing leader who likes to use technology to improve the customer experience and make a meaningful difference to how our customers shop online. At Amazon, we aim to become Earth’s most Customer-Centric Company and continue to innovate the way we engage with our customers through various marketing programs.

Critical missions of Paid Social and Creators team in Mexico are 1) to drive traffic and create innovative marketing programs in existing channels to make Amazon the most preferred shopping and entertainment destination for customers in Mexico, 2) to provide the best-in-class customer experience with highly personalized engaging marketing programs to help our customers make purchasing decisions, 3) to educate and attract new customers to Amazon overall and specific offerings, and 4) to dive deep into data to gain insights and optimize marketing programs.

The Sr. Social and Creators Product Manager plays a critical role in realizing these missions, leading various online marketing functions for Amazon.com.mx, managing and improving the marketing programs in Social Media Advertising and Creators Marketing. They will also be responsible for driving innovation by owning internally developed automated marketing products and platforms by leveraging the Amazon’s technologies. This position is one of the key senior roles in the Mexico Marketing and Prime organization. The impact of this role is significant, accounting for a large percentage of all amazon.com.mx new customers, traffic and sales. The position reports to the Head of Automated Marketing for Amazon Mexico.

Key job responsibilities


 Lead formulation of Social and Creators strategies for Mexico, including identifying key target customer segments, competitive environment, our program’s strengths and areas to invest for future innovations
 Manage, improve and innovate marketing programs, such as Automated Invoicing solutions, Social Ads, creators products.
 Drive topline while managing marketing budget, meeting ROI criteria.
 Deliver results and help Amazon meet or exceed goals in sales, profitability, new customers, and various high-value Amazon programs such as Prime membership.
 Work directly with tech teams across Amazon to define and get new development projects on tech roadmap
 Develop strong relationships and work collaboratively with the category leadership to achieve shared goals.
 Work closely with central Automated Marketing stakeholders and technical resources to ensure the company’s infrastructure, architecture, and site features support and enhance the effectiveness of Automated Marketing team’s programs.
 Identify the unique opportunities and challenges in Mexico by leveraging learnings from customer insights
 Share and learn worldwide best practices to mutually help worldwide marketing teams achieve goals.


About The Team

Inclusive team culture

At Amazon we embrace our differences and we are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We host annual and ongoing learning experiences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 16 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

Work Life Balance

We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

Mentorship & Career Growth

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications


 7+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
 Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
 Experience with end to end product delivery
 Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
 Experience as a product manager or owner
 Experience owning technology products
 Experience in English-language communication skills, both written and verbal
 Bachelor's degree or equivalent


Preferred Qualifications


 Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights
 Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders
 Experience in delivering end-to-end customer research studies, including study design, fieldwork (qualitative research moderation and survey execution), analysis, recommendations, reporting and presentation of results to senior leadership


Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

Working At Bitso

We are a diverse team that takes pride in understanding the perspectives of others. We fully embrace working remotely and we are eager to act, improve and accelerate progress inside and outside of our organization.

To drive revolutionary changes in society and make crypto useful, we delight our customers with world-class products, deep care, and intentional empathy.

Your Purpose 

We're looking for a resourceful, analytical, and execution-obsessed B2B Growth Marketing Specialist to become the operational backbone of our marketing team. This is a hybrid role that spans demand generation, event operations, campaign execution, and marketing ops, all with a relentless focus on pipeline growth and efficiency.

You'll own programs end-to-end: from building the strategy and managing vendor relationships to tracking budgets, analyzing results, and iterating fast. Events are an important part of the mix, but so are ABM plays, content-driven lead gen, partner marketing, and everything in between.

We need someone who doesn't wait for instructions. You see a gap, you fill it. You use AI tools daily to multiply your output. You're as comfortable building a campaign report in HubSpot as you are negotiating a venue contract or writing a landing page brief. About the job

Paid Ads Strategist

Remote | Medical Aesthetics Marketing | 30-35 Client Portfolio







We Don't Need a Media Buyer. We Need a Marketer.

If you think your job ends when someone clicks an ad, this isn't for you.

We need someone who obsesses over the entire journey: Ad → Landing Page → Email/SMS → Booking → Treatment. We don't celebrate leads. We celebrate people walking through the door.







The Role

You're a full-stack marketer who's deep in Meta and Google ads but understands how everything connects. You can write killer ad copy, optimize a landing page, fix a broken funnel, and explain strategy on a client call.

You'll manage paid advertising for 30-40 medical spa clients and drive the strategy for your portfolio with the support of an Account Manager.







What You Actually Do

Lead Strategy

Run weekly internal team meetings - what's working, what's not, what to test
Analyze full funnel performance: ads, landing pages, follow-up, bookings
Make calls on when to scale, pivot, or pause

Execute Campaigns

Build and optimize Meta and Google campaigns daily
Write ad copy that converts
Test creative angles, audiences, offers, landing pages
Optimize for bookings and treatment rates, not just leads

Think Full Funnel

Fix broken landing pages that aren't converting
Design email/SMS sequences that drive bookings
Understand consumer psychology: What makes someone book their first Botox?
Connect ad spend to actual practice revenue

Collaborate

Work with designers on creative concepts and angles (you're the creative director)
Partner with Account Manager on client strategy
Join client calls when performance needs strategic intervention
Spot upsell opportunities







You're the Right Person If:

✅ Expert in Meta ads, strong in Google Ads - with 3+ years experience and proven results

✅ Can write compelling ad copy and landing page copy

✅ Understand full-funnel marketing (not just traffic)

✅ Comfortable on client calls explaining strategy

✅ Lead meetings with clear POV, not just data dumps

✅ Collaborate with designers like a creative director

✅ Constant learner who studies competitors and tests new approaches

✅ Care about business outcomes (bookings) not vanity metrics (leads)

Bonus: Medical aesthetics background, GoHighLevel knowledge







What We DON'T Want

❌ Media buyers who optimize in a vacuum

❌ Order-takers waiting to be told what to do

❌ People who think "leads are up" = success

❌ Specialists who can't see the bigger picture







About Tier3 Media

We're a digital marketing agency exclusively serving 100+ medical spas nationwide. We're growth partners who understand the aesthetics industry deeply.

What we offer: Ownership over your portfolio, clear growth path, cutting-edge tools, remote flexibility, competitive pay

About the job

Hey there!

description:
About the job

About The Team

The Touring Buyer Experience (TBEX) team owns the end-to-end touring experience across web, iOS, and Android. We work as a cross-platform product engineering team with shared ownership of the customer experience, partnering across functions to build seamless, measurable experiences that help more customers move confidently through their home-buying journey. We are also deeply AI-forward in how we build with standard AI-assisted coding across the team, shipping across all parts of the stack with on-call and cross-stack ownership.

About The Role

This is not a standard Senior Software Development Engineer role. We’re looking for a mobile product builder who can take an ambiguous idea and turn it into a shipped, instrumented, and continuously improving customer experience. In this role, you’ll partner closely with product, design, and engineering peers to shape solutions, build across mobile and supporting services when needed, and use AI-assisted tools as part of day-to-day development while remaining accountable for quality, correctness, customer experience, and results.

You Will Get To


Turn ambiguous product ideas into clear scope, technical plans, tradeoffs, and success metrics. 
Build and improve mobile experiences across iOS and Android, contributing to backend services or APIs when needed. 
Partner closely with product, design, data, and engineering teammates to shape solutions and challenge assumptions. 
Balance cross-platform consistency with thoughtful platform-specific user experience decisions. 
Ship features with the right testing strategy, rollout plan, monitoring, and rollback safeguards. 
Use production signals, customer behavior, and metrics to learn from launches and improve the experience over time. 
Raise the quality bar through design feedback, code reviews, mentoring, and strong day-to-day engineering practices. 


This role has been categorized as a teleworker position. Teleworkers do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and instead work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. Employees may live anywhere in Mexico, with availability to travel to Mexico City, as we recommend attendance at occasional office events.

In addition to a competitive base salary and benefits, this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location.

Who you are


You have significant experience building and shipping production mobile applications on iOS and/or Android. 
You are comfortable working across the stack, including mobile clients, APIs, services, and data considerations, when needed to deliver outcomes. 
You have experience supporting production systems, participating in on-call rotations, and using observability and operational signals to guide improvements. 
You have a track record of owning features end to end, from ambiguous problem definition through launch and post-launch iteration. 
You bring strong technical, product, and business judgment, and can connect engineering decisions to customer and company impact. 
You collaborate effectively with cross-functional partners and communicate clearly in writing and verbally, including in asynchronous environments. 
You have depth in one mobile platform and working familiarity with the other, with the ability to reason about cross-platform experiences and backend-connected issues. 
You are comfortable using AI-assisted development tools in day-to-day work while maintaining accountability for quality, correctness, and customer experience. 
Here at Zillow - we value the experience and perspective of candidates with non-traditional backgrounds. We encourage you to apply if you have transferable skills or related experiences. 


Get to know us

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help customers navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company that's reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.

Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the country. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2025, and included on the PEOPLE Companies That Care® 2025 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.

No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.

Zillow Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact your recruiter directly.

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable state and local law.

Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. About the job

Hey there!

We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.

Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!

Ready to be part of the experience?

Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

Meet The Team

Fever for Business (F4B) is our B2B organization, built around a simple idea: providing live experiences as a service to other businesses.

We help businesses, schools and global brands create memorable events without the usual complexity by providing a reliable, scalable, and high-quality service.

From intimate Candlelight Private Concert or a large-scale multi-city activation, we turn live entertainment into a repeatable business solution that drives employee engagement and brand differentiation. Our team owns the full journey from initial sales and strategy to global execution working closely with Fever Originals and Operations to scale B2B experiences smoothly and at a global level.

Join us if you are excited about redefining B2B entertainment, build global partnerships, and turn world-class culture into a seamless business service.

The Role

We are looking for a tenured Sr. Account Executive to help build and scale our emerging Fever for Business unit across LATAM, bringing the full power of Fever to corporate and institutional clients in a fast-growing market. In this role, you will take ownership of a targeted book of business within the Strategic & Enterprise segments, while also shaping our local go-to-market approach - defining strategy, advising prospects on their needs within the culture and live entertainment space and driving net new revenue. Your expertise in consultative selling, combined with strong deal execution and cross-functional alignment, will be critical to accelerating our expansion and establishing a high-impact B2B presence in the region.

What You'll Do


Own the relationship with Fever’s Enterprise and Strategic prospects and clients in your territory
Consistently meet and exceed monthly and quarterly revenue targets
Take ownership in pipeline creation and deal cycle management, applying MEDDIC-style Sales methodologies
Drive New Logo growth and a land & expand motion for our top tier customers

description:
About the job

Description

Are you a UX/UI-minded content strategist who thrives on turning complex information into simple, conversion-driven experiences? Are you energized by the challenge of helping small and medium businesses in Mexico discover the tools they need to grow? Do you want to own the digital front door for one of the fastest-growing seller marketplaces in Latin America?

If this sounds like your kind of challenge, consider joining the Mexico Marketplace team as a Content and Website Manager.

What You Will Do?

This role owns the end-to-end content experience on vender.amazon.com.mx, the primary destination for prospective sellers exploring how to sell on Amazon Mexico. The mission is clear: make it effortless for potential sellers to find, understand, and act on the information they need to start their business on Amazon.

You will combine UX/UI expertise with content strategy and data analysis to continuously improve the site experience. You will track free search sources to understand how sellers discover the site, then optimize every touchpoint from first click to completed registration.

To succeed, you will need to think like a designer, write like a marketer, and measure like an analyst, all while collaborating across a diverse set of internal teams.

Core Responsibilities

UX/UI Strategy and Execution: Own the information architecture, page layouts, and user flows on vender.amazon.com.mx. Ensure every page delivers a clear value proposition, intuitive navigation, and a frictionless path toward seller registration. Conduct usability reviews, propose wireframes, and work with design resources to implement improvements.

Content Management at Scale: Plan, create, publish, and maintain site content including landing pages, educational modules, FAQs, and program explainers. Ensure content is accurate, up-to-date, and aligned with active seller programs and promotions.

Free Search Source Tracking: Monitor organic traffic performance across Google and AI-powered search surfaces. Identify keyword opportunities, track ranking changes, and coordinate content updates to maximize discoverability without paid spend.

Conversion Optimization: Own the visitor-to-registration funnel. Design and run A/B tests on layouts, copy, and CTAs. Analyze drop-off points, recommend improvements backed by data, and report on conversion metrics to leadership.

Cross-Functional Partnership: Collaborate daily with Program Managers, Product Managers, and Commercial teams. Translate business priorities, new program launches, and policy changes into user-friendly site content within rapid turnaround cycles.

Performance Reporting: Build and maintain dashboards that track organic traffic, conversion rates, content freshness, and page experience scores. Deliver monthly insights to stakeholders with clear recommendations for next steps.

What We Are Looking For

To Be Successful In This Role, You Will Demonstrate

A strong UX/UI foundation: experience with wireframing, prototyping, user research, and usability testing.

A true hands-on approach to content creation and site management, comfortable rolling up your sleeves in the CMS daily.

The ability to translate complex business and program information into simple, action-oriented content that converts.

A data-driven mindset: comfort defining KPIs, running experiments, interpreting analytics, and presenting results.

Strong internal customer service focus, able to interface at all levels of the organization, from operational teams to senior leadership.

A solutions-oriented approach: comfortable identifying problems and driving appropriate fixes without waiting for direction.

Bias for action, strong work ethic, and desire to achieve excellence in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

Enthusiasm for collaborative work and a drive to create a positive, high-performance team culture.

Success in this role requires influential partnership with Program, Product, and Commercial teams to ensure vender.amazon.com.mx delivers the best possible experience for potential sellers in Mexico. If you are passionate about using design thinking and content strategy to change the trajectory of small businesses, this role is for you.

Key job responsibilities

Own the content strategy and UX/UI experience on vender.amazon.com.mx, ensuring prospective sellers in Mexico can easily discover, understand, and act on the information needed to start selling on Amazon.

Design and maintain site user flows, page layouts, and information architecture. Conduct usability reviews and implement improvements that reduce friction in the seller registration funnel.

Plan, publish, and update site content (landing pages, FAQs, educational modules) in coordination with Program, Product, and Commercial teams. Ensure all content reflects current programs and promotions within 48 to 72 hours of changes.

Track and analyze free search traffic sources. Identify organic keyword opportunities, monitor ranking performance, and optimize content for discoverability across search engines and AI-powered surfaces.

Run A/B tests on layouts, messaging, and CTAs. Measure conversion at each funnel stage, report findings to stakeholders, and implement data-backed improvements.

Partner cross-functionally to translate complex business requirements into clear, conversion-oriented site experiences. Serve as the primary point of contact for all content and UX requests related to the Mexico seller acquisition site.

Maintain performance dashboards covering organic traffic, conversion rates, and page experience scores. Deliver monthly insights with actionable recommendations.

A day in the life

You start the day reviewing organic traffic dashboards, identifying which pages are gaining traction and where drop-offs occur. You then jump into the CMS to publish updated landing page content requested by the Program team. Mid-morning, you join a sync with Product Managers to align on an upcoming registration flow change and plan the corresponding site updates. After lunch, you review A/B test results, document findings, and share recommendations with the Commercial team. Your customer is the prospective seller in Mexico who needs a clear, frictionless path from search result to completed registration.

About The Team

The Seller Marketing Team owns the full marketing funnel for Amazon Mexico's seller ecosystem. The mission: make Amazon the first choice for every business in Mexico looking to sell online. The team attracts potential sellers, converts them into registrations, and keeps them engaged and growing. This means working across awareness, acquisition, and retention, always with a bias toward experimentation and measurable impact. The culture is fast-paced, collaborative, and seller-obsessed. Team members take ownership of outcomes end-to-end and partner across product, program, and commercial functions to deliver results

Basic Qualifications


 Experience using analytical specific tools such as Google Analytics, SQL or HTML
 Experience in A/B testing
 Speak, write, and read fluently in English, and have the ability to take direction in English
 Experience in omni-channel marketing, search engine marketing or search engine optimization
 Bachelor's degree

 Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools

Help turn field insights from reps into actionable marketing and partner growth opportunities.

3. Voice of Customer & Market Intelligence

Conduct interviews with sales reps, interior designers, procurement contacts, and partner stakeholders.

Summarize findings into clear insights, recommendations, and action items.

4. Marketing Strategy & 90-Day Planning

Create actionable plans that connect marketing activity to partner growth, sales enablement, brand awareness, lead generation, and specification opportunities.

5. Content, Social & Thought Leadership

Support content planning and execution across LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, blog/editorial, newsletters, and partner channels.
Help translate product collections, trends, and design concepts into clear, engaging, audience-relevant storytelling.

Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to gather assets, organize content calendars, and support publishing workflows.

Help organize and maintain contact databases, lead lists, partner lists, rep directories, and outreach trackers.
Support CRM management for leads, samples, quotes, reps, designers, and partner activity.

The ideal candidate is a strong communicator, strategic thinker, and organized executor who understands how to connect sales support, business development, and marketing initiatives to business growth.

They should be comfortable working in a small entrepreneurial environment where priorities can shift quickly and where the ability to build structure is just as important as execution.

The ideal person is confident supporting sales teams, generating qualified opportunities, managing CRM systems (preferably HubSpot), and helping leadership build scalable sales processes while contributing to strategic marketing initiatives.

Preferred Experience

Experience working with licensed product collections or manufacturer partners
Familiarity with sales rep ecosystems, specification processes, design firms, procurement, or commercial interiors

About the job

The Pokémon GO team is seeking a Creative Production Manager, User Acquisition to build our next-generation advertising creative pipeline. In this role, you will lead all aspects of the UA creative process from concept to completion, ensuring our ads meet brand guidelines and quality standards. This role collaborates with artists, agencies and other creative professionals to integrate all of the learnings and strategies required for successful performance marketing campaigns.

Ability to use AI tools to solve workflow bottlenecks and increase output efficiency

About Scopely

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Niantic games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.

Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.

Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: https://www.scopely.com/.

Acerca de Aldea

Aldea es una plataforma para la gestión y administración de centros educativos. Hoy ayudamos a más de 400 centros (kínderes, guarderías, primarias, centros de terapia, idiomas y deporte) a optimizar su comunicación, administración y procesos pedagógicos.

¡Genial! Estamos ampliando nuestro equipo y creemos que esta oportunidad puede ser lo que estás buscando. Únete a una empresa 100% mexicana con presencia local y un producto diseñado para las necesidades de miles de centros en Latinoamérica.

About the job

Hey there — yeah, you!




HomeHop is a fast-growing short-term rental management company (think Airbnb & VRBO), and we're on the hunt for a friendly, quick-thinking individual to be the voice our guests hear when they reach out. We started with a handful of properties and now manage 120+ short-term rentals across the Midwest USA… and we're still just getting started!




If you love solving problems, thrive when things move fast, and get a little thrill from checking things off a list — keep reading.




What you'll actually be doing

You'll be our guest's go-to person. Someone messages asking where to park, how the hot tub works, or whether they can check in early? You've got them — warm, fast, and helpful every time. Guest messaging is a big part of this role… but it's not the whole role.




Because we're a startup, no two shifts look the same. One minute you're smoothing over a booking question, the next you're helping the team knock out a random task that keeps the whole machine running. We wear a lot of hats around here, and we're looking for someone who's happy to grab one and jump in.




A taste of the day-to-day:

Chatting with guests across Airbnb, VRBO, and our direct booking channels — keeping it prompt, professional, and genuinely friendly
Handling reservations, questions, and the occasional "help, I locked myself out" moment
Coordinating with cleaning and maintenance crews to keep stays running smoothly
Jumping in on all kinds of team tasks and projects as we grow — flexibility is the name of the game
Keeping notes and records tidy so nothing slips through the cracks
Using critical thinking when problems with guests arise




The schedule:

Friday, Saturday & Sunday, 1:00 PM – 11:00 PM EST — these are our busiest hours and your time to shine
You'll need to work on American holidays (guests travel most when everyone else is off)
5 days of PTO to start




You'll fit right in if you…

Write like a real, warm human — clear, kind, and typo-free
Stay cool under pressure and can juggle a few things at once
Are tech-savvy and comfortable bouncing between apps and platforms
Have experience with short-term rentals or Airbnb (a big plus!)
Are based in Mexico and ready to work fully remote
Actually like helping people




Why HomeHop?

We're a small, scrappy, supportive team that believes work should be fun — not a corporate snooze-fest. We move fast, we back each other up, we celebrate wins, and there's real room to grow as we do!




Ready to hop in?

Hit apply and tell us a little about yourself. We can't wait to meet you!!

Together, we are Marken, UPS Healthcare Precision Logistics. As the clinical and advanced therapy part of UPS Healthcare, we reach patients faster, with greater scalability and access to new pathways throughout the supply chain. With our One UPS advantage and comprehensive service portfolio, including Polar Speed's in-network pharmacies, we are optimally positioned to keep our clients competitive in an increasingly complex market.

Job Summary

The Customer Relations Specialist is responsible for handling and processing UPS customers' complaints about package delivery problems (i.e., missing and damaged items) and service failures (i.e., missed deliveries). He/She handles and processes customers' issues and complaint phone calls (i.e., calls to UPS Corporate Headquarters, Global Business Services, and UPS telephone package line), emails, faxes, and letters. The Customer Relations Specialist utilizes customer information databases to build customers' complaint profiles, summarizes and highlights customers' issues, and determines UPS location responsibility (e.g., District Managers, Operations Centers, etc.) for resolving customers' issues. He/She acts diplomatically to handle calls from VIPs and diffuses and stabilizes calls from frustrated customers. This position processes correspondence from attorneys and states' attorneys general to ensure requests, demands, and inquiries are processed correctly within established deadlines.

Descrição Do Cargo

Together, we are Marken, UPS Healthcare Precision Logistics. As the clinical and advanced therapy part of UPS Healthcare, we reach patients faster, with greater scalability and access to new pathways throughout the supply chain. With our One UPS advantage and comprehensive service portfolio, including Polar Speed's in-network pharmacies, we are optimally positioned to keep our clients competitive in an increasingly complex market.

Job Summary

The Customer Relations Specialist is responsible for handling and processing UPS customers' complaints about package delivery problems (i.e., missing and damaged items) and service failures (i.e., missed deliveries). He/She handles and processes customers' issues and complaint phone calls (i.e., calls to UPS Corporate Headquarters, Global Business Services, and UPS telephone package line), emails, faxes, and letters. This position is responsible for handling calls originally directed to UPS senior management and Management Committee members, managing the resolution process and reporting back to UPS senior management and Management Committee members on issue and complaint resolutions. The Customer Relations Specialist utilizes customer information databases to build customers' complaint profiles, summarizes and highlights customers' issues, and determines UPS location responsibility (e.g., District Managers, Operations Centers, etc.) for resolving customers' issues. This position interacts with UPS corporate departments (i.e., Public Relations, Legal, and Security) to ensure departments are notified of customers' issues and develop reports for Customer Relations and UPS senior management, summarizing customers' issues and resolutions. He/She acts diplomatically to handle calls from VIPs and diffuses and stabilizes calls from frustrated customers. This position processes correspondence from attorneys and states' attorneys general to ensure requests, demands, and inquiries are processed correctly within established deadlines.

Tipo De Colaborador

Permanente

About the job

Description

Amazon Marketplace is seeking a dynamic and motivated executive to define the 3P Consumables strategy partnering with key stakeholders. The Consumables categories include Beauty, Health and Personal Care, Beer, Wine and Spirits, Pets and Baby, among others.

Specifically, this individual will be responsible for identifying and building relationships with key influencers and decision-makers within the executive teams of existing Consumables strategic accounts and programs, along with internal stakeholders and cross-functional teams to create and present compelling Amazon solutions that meet and exceed customer requirements. The account manager will build the success of those accounts and programs by providing business insights, training, support and seller education.

The Category Merchant Manager Consumables will have P&L responsibilities, as well as owning and managing key KPIs such as selection, pricing and availability.

 Define and implement the Consumables strategy for Sellers and programs

Amazon Services’ Business Development organization connects the technology powering Amazon.com to businesses worldwide. We are responsible for establishing new business partnerships with sellers who wish to utilize Amazon’s suite of e-commerce solutions. For more information, please visit

 Experience positioning and selling innovative solutions to new and existing customers and market segments

About the job

EL EQUIPO




El equipo de Marketing Digital es el motor creativo y estratégico que posiciona los eventos en las plataformas más relevantes. Diseñamos campañas digitales que generan awareness, tráfico y conversión, trabajando de la mano con promotores y plataformas globales.




DESCRIPCIÓN DEL CARGO




Como Trafficker Digital, serás responsable de implementar y dar seguimiento a campañas en plataformas como Meta, Google, Spotify y TikTok, asegurando que cada acción esté alineada con la estrategia y el presupuesto aprobado. Tu rol será clave para maximizar el impacto de nuestras campañas y garantizar resultados medibles.

Estamos en un momento emocionante: la industria del entretenimiento en vivo está creciendo y Ticketmaster lidera esta transformación con estrategias digitales innovadoras. Este puesto te permitirá trabajar con grandes marcas, plataformas globales y eventos que marcan tendencia.







LO QUE HARÁS




Implementar campañas digitales en plataformas como Meta, Google, Spotify, TikTok y plataformas de Programatic.
Monitorear y controlar la correcta ejecución de campañas según presupuesto y estrategia.
Elaborar reportes de desempeño y gasto de campañas digitales.
Analizar métricas en tiempo real para realizar ajustes y optimizar resultados.
Dar seguimiento a solicitudes de promotores para asegurar cumplimiento de fechas y materiales.
Presentar resultados y cierres de campañas a clientes internos y externos a nivel internacional, Ticketmaste Global, por lo que hablar inglés es indispensable.
Interactuar con ejecutivos de plataformas digitales para resolver dudas y explorar mejoras.
Colaborar con áreas internas para validar estrategias y garantizar la correcta implementación.




LO QUE NECESITAS SABER (o HABILIDADES TÉCNICAS)




Licenciatura en Comunicación, Marketing, Publicidad o afín.
Mínimo 2 años de experiencia en implementación de campañas.
Dominio de plataformas Paid Media (Meta Ads, Google Ads, Spotify, TikTok, Programatic).
Conocimiento en Google Analytics y herramientas de medición.
Inglés B2-C1, indispensable.




TÚ (BEHAVIOURAL SKILLS)

Te apasiona el marketing digital y las tendencias en redes sociales.
Actúas con enfoque en resultados y atención al detalle.
Colaboras activamente con otros equipos y clientes.
Tienes capacidad de análisis y toma de decisiones.
Te adaptas a entornos dinámicos y trabajas bajo presión.










VIDA EN TICKETMASTER

Nos enorgullece formar parte de Live Nation Entertainment, la empresa de

entretenimiento en vivo más grande del mundo. Nuestra visión en Ticketmaster es

conectar a las personas alrededor del mundo con los eventos en vivo que aman.

Como el mercado de boletos más grande del mundo y el proveedor global líder de

herramientas y servicios para la industria del entretenimiento en vivo, estamos en una

posición única para cumplir con esa visión.

Lo hacemos todo con una pasión intensa por el entretenimiento en vivo y una cultura inspiradora y diversa, impulsada por líderes accesibles, gerentes atentos y equipos entusiastas. Si te apasiona el entretenimiento en vivo como a nosotros, y deseas trabajar en una empresa dedicada a ayudar a millones de fanáticos a vivir esa experiencia, queremos saber de ti.

Nuestra labor se guía por nuestros valores:

Fiabilidad: Entendemos que los fanáticos y clientes dependen de nosotros para hacer posible sus experiencias en eventos en vivo, y nosotros dependemos los unos de los otros para lograrlo.
Trabajo en equipo: Creemos que el logro individual es insignificante en comparación con el éxito que se puede lograr en equipo.
Integridad: Estamos comprometidos con los más altos estándares morales y éticos en nombre de los innumerables socios y partes interesadas que representamos.
Sentido de pertenencia: Estamos comprometidos a construir una cultura en la que todas las personas puedan ser su yo auténtico, tengan voz igualitaria y oportunidades para prosperar.




OPORTUNIDADES IGUALES




Estamos apasionados y comprometidos con nuestra gente, y vamos más allá de la retórica sobre diversidad e inclusión. Trabajarás en un entorno inclusivo y se te alentará a ser tú mismo en el trabajo. Haremos todo lo posible para ayudarte a equilibrar exitosamente tu vida laboral y personal. Como negocio en crecimiento, fomentaremos que desarrolles tanto tus aspiraciones profesionales como personales, disfrutes de nuevas experiencias y aprendas de las personas talentosas con las que trabajarás. Nos importa el talento, y alentamos las postulaciones de personas sin importar su género, raza, orientación sexual, religión, edad, estado de discapacidad o responsabilidades familiares.

description:
About the job

Estoy ayudando a Afincore a encontrar al mejor candidato para unirse a su equipo flexible para el rol de AI Sales Partner.




Convertirás problemas críticos de negocio en soluciones ejecutables de datos, IA y software.




Compensación:

USD 0/mes




Ubicación:

Remoto: México




Misión de Afincore:

"Desarrollar infraestructura de inteligencia artificial, datos y software empresarial que permita a las organizaciones tomar decisiones estratégicas con mayor precisión."




¿Qué te hace un candidato ideal?

Eres competente en Venta consultiva, Gestión comercial, Desarrollo de red de contactos, Desarrollo de negocios, CRM.
Tienes potencial para desarrollar Snowflake, SPIN selling, Rentabilidad, Microsoft Azure, Intelligent automation (IA), Ingeniería de datos, Finanzas corporativas.
Español - Completamente fluido
Inglés - Conversacional




Responsabilidades y más:

AI Sales Partner




Business Development & AI Solutions - Afincore




Ubicación: México / Remoto

Modalidad: Contractor por proyecto

Compensación: 10% de utilidades netas por proyecto cerrado

Nivel: Mid-Senior / Senior




Sobre Afincore




Afincore es una firma de inteligencia corporativa, ingeniería de datos, infraestructura de IA y desarrollo de soluciones tecnológicas para negocios.




Ayudamos a empresas, grupos empresariales y equipos directivos a convertir datos dispersos, reportes manuales y decisiones intuitivas en sistemas de inteligencia empresarial: Command Centers, Control Towers, Profitability Engines, Growth Control Systems, AI Operating Layers y Enterprise Intelligence OS.




No construimos dashboards genéricos. Construimos infraestructura de decisión.




Sobre el Rol




Buscamos un AI Sales Partner para originar, desarrollar y convertir oportunidades comerciales en proyectos reales de datos, IA, analítica y software para Afincore.




La persona será responsable de identificar organizaciones con problemas relevantes de información, rentabilidad, operación, reporting, crecimiento o automatización; abrir conversaciones con los decisores adecuados; entender el problema y trabajar con el liderazgo y equipo técnico de Afincore para construir una solución comercial y técnicamente viable.




Este no es un rol de venta transaccional ni de colocación de licencias cerradas. Afincore desarrolla soluciones personalizadas: para un cliente la arquitectura adecuada puede apoyarse en MotherDuck; para otro en Snowflake, AWS, herramientas existentes o una combinación distinta.




Trabajarás de forma remota y con alta autonomía, participando desde la prospección y discovery hasta la propuesta, negociación, cierre y transición del proyecto al equipo de implementación.




Qué harás




* Identificar y prospectar empresas con problemas que puedan resolverse mediante datos, IA, analítica o software.

* Construir y gestionar pipeline comercial mediante outbound, referidos, networking, alianzas y otras fuentes de oportunidad.

* Abrir conversaciones con dueños, CEOs, CFOs, COOs y otros decisores relevantes.

* Liderar reuniones iniciales de discovery para entender el negocio antes de proponer tecnología.

* Detectar problemas como información fragmentada, reportes manuales, falta de visibilidad operativa, márgenes desconocidos, forecasting débil, procesos repetitivos o sistemas desconectados.

* Trabajar con clientes que, en ocasiones, llegan con información desordenada y necesitan estructurar el problema prácticamente desde cero.

* Coordinar con el CEO y equipo técnico de Afincore diagnósticos, arquitecturas preliminares y propuestas.

* Presentar soluciones de forma ejecutiva, explicando valor, alcance, fases y lógica económica sin recurrir a hype tecnológico.

* Dar seguimiento a propuestas, negociación, cierre y handoff al equipo de delivery.

* Mantener disciplina de CRM, seguimiento, forecast comercial y documentación de oportunidades.

* Desarrollar alianzas y convertir aprendizajes de mercado en inteligencia reutilizable para el go-to-market de Afincore.




Soluciones que Comercializarás




Sistemas de Inteligencia Empresarial: Command Centers, Control Towers, Growth Control Systems, AI Operating Layers y Enterprise Intelligence OS.




Rentabilidad y Performance: Profitability Engines, unit economics, rentabilidad por cliente, producto, proyecto, activo o unidad de negocio, FP&A, forecasting y simulación.




Data & Analytics Engineering: Integración de Excel, ERPs, CRMs, bases SQL, APIs y otras fuentes; pipelines ETL/ELT, modelado de datos, calidad, reconciliación y plataformas modernas de datos.




IA Aplicada: RAG, agentes internos, búsqueda semántica, automatización de análisis, document intelligence, copilotos y workflows empresariales asistidos por IA.




Software y Data Apps: Aplicaciones ejecutivas, APIs, automatizaciones, herramientas operativas y software a medida conectado con datos y procesos reales.




Arquitectura a Medida: Soluciones construidas con el stack adecuado para cada caso, incluyendo MotherDuck, Snowflake, AWS u otras alternativas cuando aporten valor real.




Requisitos




* Experiencia en ventas B2B consultivas, business development, partnerships o desarrollo de cuentas.

* Capacidad real para generar oportunidades y construir pipeline propio.

* Experiencia conversando con decisores senior y vendiendo soluciones o proyectos de ticket relevante.

* Capacidad para entender problemas de negocio antes de presentar una solución.

* Familiaridad conceptual con datos, IA, cloud, automatización y software; no es necesario ser ingeniero.

* Excelente comunicación, negociación y seguimiento comercial.

* Autonomía para trabajar bajo esquema remoto y contractor.

* Disciplina, responsabilidad y disponibilidad real para atender oportunidades activas.

* Alto sentido de confidencialidad y visión de largo plazo.




Deseable




* Experiencia vendiendo consultoría tecnológica, data engineering, analytics, IA, cloud, software empresarial o transformación digital.

* Conocimiento general de plataformas como Snowflake, Databricks, MotherDuck, AWS, Azure, GCP o equivalentes.

* Red de contactos B2B en México con dueños, C-level o líderes de finanzas, operaciones, comercial y tecnología.

* Familiaridad con metodologías como SPIN Selling, Challenger o MEDDICC/MEDDPICC.

* Conocimiento de finanzas corporativas, FP&A, unit economics, procesos operativos o rentabilidad.

* Experiencia desarrollando alianzas, canales o ecosistemas comerciales.

* Inglés profesional.




Perfil ideal




Buscamos un operador comercial capaz de moverse entre negocio y tecnología sin caer en discurso superficial de IA.




Una persona que pueda conversar con un empresario sobre margen, crecimiento, inventario, flujo de caja, productividad o control operativo; detectar dónde existe un problema real; y después abrir el espacio correcto para que Afincore diseñe una solución con datos, software e IA.




No buscamos a alguien que solo envíe mensajes masivos, repita un pitch fijo o prometa tecnología antes de entender el contexto.




Buscamos criterio comercial, capacidad de seguimiento, ownership y disciplina para convertir oportunidades complejas en proyectos ejecutables.




Afincore respeta que el contractor pueda tener otros trabajos o proyectos. A cambio, exige responsabilidad, respuesta oportuna, reservas reales de tiempo para oportunidades activas y cumplimiento riguroso de los compromisos asumidos.




Qué Ofrecemos




* Participar en la construcción del motor comercial de Afincore desde una etapa temprana.

* Representar un offering de alto valor en inteligencia corporativa, ingeniería de datos, IA aplicada y software.

* Trabajar sobre problemas reales de negocio en múltiples industrias.

* Acceso directo al liderazgo y equipo técnico de Afincore para discovery, propuestas y cierres estratégicos.

* Libertad para proponer cuentas objetivo, verticales, alianzas y enfoques de go-to-market.

* Esquema remoto con autonomía y responsabilidad.

* Esquema contractor con participación del 10% en utilidades netas por cada proyecto cerrado.

* Potencial de crecimiento hacia mayor responsabilidad comercial conforme Afincore escale.




Afincore busca perfiles comerciales con criterio, disciplina y capacidad real para convertir problemas críticos de negocio en oportunidades ejecutables de datos, IA y software.




Tu(s) posible(s) líder(es):

Juan - CEO



Desired Skills and Experience

Venta consultiva, Gestión comercial, Desarrollo de red de contactos, Desarrollo de negocios, CRM, Snowflake, SPIN selling, Rentabilidad, Microsoft Azure, Intelligent automation (IA)

description:
About the job

This is Adyen

Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition.

For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster.

Why You Should Join the Workplace Team at Adyen

At Adyen, our Workplace team plays a vital role in ensuring a seamless, efficient, and welcoming environment for every employee. From creating an inviting first impression as soon as you enter our offices, to designing, building, and maintaining inclusive, comfortable, and collaborative workspaces across the globe, we are dedicated to supporting the best possible work experience for all Adyen team members. We aim to create an environment where everyone can perform at their best.

We are looking for an organized, proactive, and detail-oriented Office Coordinator to join us in overseeing daily operations at our Mexico office. In this role, you’ll be an integral part of the team, working to support Adyen’s mission and vision. We value partnership, clear communication, and a customer-focused mindset, as you will serve as an internal ambassador for the Adyen brand, ensuring that our offices meet the highest standards for employees, guests, and clients.

What You’ll Do


Vendor Management- Support the Brazil Workplace/Office Management team in maintaining high standards across custodial, maintenance, and other onsite service partners. Manage vendor performance, gathering COIs and compliance documentation, and helping ensure service delivery aligns with expectations.
Facilities Support- Monitor and track facilities requests to support timely resolution of onsite issues. Manage with daily operations by coordinating with internal teams and service vendors to help maintain a safe and functional workplace.
Process Improvement- Assist in identifying areas where office operations can be improved. Collaborate with the team to streamline workflows and support implementation of updated processes.
Expense Tracking & Financial Support- Help track office-related expenses and manage invoice submissions. Work closely with the BR Workplace team and Finance to support timely processing and alignment with approved financial guidelines.
Project Support- Provide logistical and administrative support for office projects. Assist with planning, coordination, and execution to help ensure project success.
Sustainability Initiatives- Work with the Global Workplace to support sustainability efforts in the office, including gathering information and coordinating implementation of environmentally friendly practices.
Event Support- Assist with the planning and execution of internal events, including logistical coordination and vendor communication, to ensure seamless experiences and strong employee engagement.
Safety & Security Support- Collaborate with the Head of Physical Safety and Security to support emergency preparedness activities. Help coordinate training sessions, emergency drills, and rollout of safety protocols across the office.


Who You Are


Approachable and Personable- You are someone who thrives building relationships, whether welcoming visitors to the office, addressing employee inquiries, or giving constructive feedback on office-related matters.
Highly Organized- You excel in fast-paced environments, balancing multiple tasks at once, and ensuring everything is running smoothly. Your attention to detail is key to making sure nothing slips through the cracks.
Proactive Problem Solver- You take initiative, thinking ahead and making decisions when necessary, while maintaining a positive, solution-oriented attitude.
Collaborative Team Player- You believe in the power of teamwork and putting collective goals ahead of individual ego. You communicate effectively and enjoy working within a diverse, global team.
Flexible & Adaptable- With a global mindset, you’re comfortable working across cultures, time zones, and changing circumstances. You embrace challenges with a can-do attitude.
Hands-On and Detail-Oriented- Whether you're organizing an office event or troubleshooting an operational issue, you are hands-on and take pride in ensuring everything is executed to the highest standard.


Additional Requirements


A minimum of 4 years experience in a similar role, with a background in office management and workplace operations.
Vendor management experience working with a variety of infrastructure service providers.
Proven ability to manage projects and work collaboratively across teams, ensuring alignment and seamless execution.
On-site presence- This is an office-based role, requiring a daily presence in our Mexico location - 5 days per week.

Our business and technical challenges are unique, and we need as many different voices as possible to join us in solving them - voices like yours. About the job

Descripción de la empresa Forney Corporation es una empresa con más de 90 años de liderazgo en sistemas de plantas de energía y grandes instalaciones industriales, especializada en el diseño, fabricación, instalación y mantenimiento de equipos de combustión innovadores. Su catálogo incluye encendedores, detectores de llama, sistemas de gestión de quemadores (BMS), quemadores, duct burners y compuertas. Con oficinas de campo y representantes de ventas en todo el mundo, Forney ofrece soporte local de producto y aplicaciones a sus clientes. La empresa apuesta por la fiabilidad, la seguridad y la innovación tecnológica, creando un entorno atractivo para profesionales que buscan desarrollarse en el sector industrial y energético.

Descripción del puesto En el puesto de HR Generalist en Forney Corporation, te encargarás de dar soporte integral a las funciones de recursos humanos en la empresa, asegurando una gestión eficaz y alineada con las políticas corporativas. En tu día a día administrarás procesos de selección y onboarding, coordinarás la gestión de beneficios de personas empleadas, apoyarás la implementación y actualización de políticas de RR. HH. y colaborarás en la resolución de consultas y necesidades del personal. También participarás en la gestión del desempeño, en iniciativas de formación y desarrollo, y en tareas administrativas relacionadas con la documentación laboral y la actualización de bases de datos de personas empleadas. Serás responsable de la nómina y procesos de IMSS e Infonavit. Este es un puesto de tiempo completo, presencial y ubicado en Santa Catarina, NLE.

Requisitos

title: Portuguese Language Data Contributor (Multimodal) – Freelance AI Trainer Project
description:
About the job

Are you a Portuguese (Brazil) language expert eager to shape the future of AI? Large‑scale language models are evolving from clever chatbots into powerful engines of linguistic discovery. With high‑quality training data, tomorrow’s AI can democratize world‑class education, keep pace with cutting‑edge research, and streamline communication for Portuguese speakers everywhere. That training data begins with you—we need your expertise to help power the next generation of AI.

We’re looking for Portuguese (Brazil) language specialists who live and breathe phonetics, morphology, syntax, semantics, pragmatics, and sociolinguistics of the Portuguese language. You’ll challenge advanced language models on topics like verb conjugation, noun-adjective agreement, sentence structure, word order, accentuation, and colloquial expressions—documenting every failure mode so we can harden model reasoning.

On a typical day, you will converse with the model on language scenarios, verify factual accuracy and logical soundness, capture reproducible error traces, and suggest improvements to our prompt engineering and evaluation metrics.

A degree in Portuguese language, linguistics, or a closely related field is ideal; peer‑reviewed publications, teaching experience, or hands‑on linguistic analysis projects signal fit. Clear, metacognitive communication—“showing your work”—is essential.

Ready to turn your Portuguese language expertise into the knowledge base for tomorrow’s AI? Apply today and start teaching the model that will teach the world.

We offer a pay range of $6-to- $65 per hour, with the exact rate determined after evaluating your experience, expertise, and geographic location. Final offer amounts may vary from the pay range listed above. As a contractor you’ll supply a secure computer and high‑speed internet; company‑sponsored benefits such as health insurance and PTO do not apply.

Data Collection & Participation Notice

This engagement involves participation in AI data collection and evaluation. Services include providing audio, video, image, and written inputs—including recordings of your voice and likeness—to support the development and refinement of AI systems.

Eligibility for this project requires that you are 18 years or older and agree to the applicable participant and consent agreements.

When providing services, submit content featuring only yourself. Avoid the inclusion of third-party or sensitive personal information to maintain project security standards.
